approval.ownerDirection: 2026-10-26: preserve full ENABLE acceptance and expand/review familiarity coverage before choosing a filter. Scored generation stays gated meanwhile.

inputs.compositeFingerprintRecipe: SHA256([base.sourceHash, supplementSha256, version, evidence].join("|")); base.sourceHash is the pinned original index SHA-256

review.basis: Original AI editorial general-use familiarity judgment only; no automatic promotion based on points or ratio.
review.acceptance: Every original matching ENABLE word remains accepted; no length cap, pangram cap, new acceptance policy or score change.
review.goals: New snapshots using this optional input freeze the augmented familiar count. Existing snapshots retain original goal/accepted/familiar sets.
review.futureFrequencyBoundary: A future frequency-backed input must have a new pinned version/hash, evidence/license review and exhaustive evaluation; unfinished work is not a dependency.
